entries.title: Guo--Tang--Wei self-consistency operator on d-ary trees (2022, Proposition 3.1)
entries.statement: Let d>=2 and 0<pi<=1/2. Use one active root frog and one sleeper per non-root vertex in the GTW single-entry non-backtracking self-similar model. A newborn moves upward with probability pi and otherwise to a uniform child; after an upward step its next upward probability is pi/[pi+(1-pi)(d-1)/d], with uniform permissible siblings, while downward paths stay downward. Stop root returns and excess subtree entries. Let V be the total returns and g(x)=E[x^V], x<1, with x^infinity=0. Then g=A_(d,pi)g on 0<=x<1. For z_k=h([pi*x+(1-pi)(k-1)/d]/[pi+(1-pi)(d-1)/d]), define P_1=z_1, Q_2=z_2^2, P_(k+1)=z_(k+1)^(k+1)-sum_(l=1)^k binom(k,l-1)z_(k+1)^(k+1-l)P_l, and Q_(k+1)=z_(k+1)^(k+1)-sum_(l=2)^k binom(k-1,l-2)z_(k+1)^(k+1-l)Q_l. The operator is A_(d,pi)h=(pi*x+(1-pi)/d)sum_(k=1)^d binom(d-1,k-1)P_k+[(d-1)(1-pi)/d]sum_(k=2)^d binom(d-2,k-2)Q_k. This is a physical-PGF identity; no general monotonicity property of the operator is asserted here.
entries.proof_text: The single-entry restriction makes the child return processes independent fresh copies when first activated. Decompose the first star by the number of visited child vertices. Lemma 3.7 identifies one-seed and two-seed closure probabilities as the universal P/Q polynomials in the displayed PGF compositions. Subtract closures on proper child subsets to obtain equations (7),(8); sum with the binomial multiplicities and the root-neighbor newborn first-step probabilities to obtain equation (6). Proposition 3.1 gives the physical fixed point.
assumptions: One sleeper per non-root vertex; independent paths
Single downward entry per subtree, root returns stopped

source.locator: Proposition 3.1, equations (5)-(8), manuscript pp.7-8; Lemma 3.7 and Section 3.4

entries.title: Draft (unaudited): four-child Guo--Tang--Wei frog PGF monotonicity and Poisson tail
entries.statement: PROOF (UNAUDITED), a lemma of w677 C15 v1; novelty unverified. For the four-child one-sleeper self-similar model at original p=19/80, pi=19/75, beta=19/61, gamma=14/61 and q=14/75. Write B=f(beta*x), C=f(beta*x+gamma), D=f(beta*x+2gamma), A=f(beta*x+3gamma), L=C^2-BC and H=D^3-BD^2-2C^2D+2BCD. The GTW polynomial is Tf=(pi*x+q)[A^4+B(1-A^3)+3(1-A^2)L+3(1-A)H]+3q[A^4+(1-A^2)C^2+2(1-A)(D^3-C^2D)]. It is monotone on 0<=B<=C<=D<=A<=1, as shown by eight explicitly factored partial derivatives. It maps finite-support PGFs to finite-support PGFs by finite star closure. For g_a(x)=exp[-a(1-x)], the draft proves Tg_a<=g_(a+1/1000) for every a>=20. With eta=15/61, exact exponential partial sums bound the small-z correction by 16739/1525000 and leave eta-K>=358261/1525000; for z>=1/2 the ratio is at most 14299/25000. These are exact rational analytic checks; no independent exact-version PASS has arrived. This lemma needs a separate finite-start domination before implying recurrence.
assumptions: One active root frog and one sleeper at each non-root vertex
Independent walks with original inward drift 19/80 and root reflection
Published GTW fixed point/lower coupling and Mathews degree monotonicity

entries.title: Draft (unaudited): w677 biased frog recurrence at 19/80 for every d>=4
entries.statement: PROOF (UNAUDITED), w677 C15_four_child_bootstrap v1; novelty unverified. For every integer d>=4, the ordinary and self-similar one-sleeper frog models on the infinite rooted d-ary tree are recurrent at original inward drift p=19/80=0.2375, with independent paths, uniform outward choices and ordinary-root reflection. Set p_d=inf{p: ordinary FM(d,p,1) is recurrent} and S_4=sup_{d>=4}p_d, as in Mathews; the draft implies S_4<=19/80. The four-child operator has newborn pi=19/75 and continuation beta=19/61. With N=10000 and scale 2^50, 1000 exact upward grid iterations certify T^1000 1<=g_20 on the full interval, including a final-cell slope of 327869939578746875/70368744177664>=20. The all-a>=20 Poisson improvement then forces the physical root-return PGF to vanish on x<1. GTW lower coupling and Mathews fixed-original-drift degree monotonicity transfer recurrence to every d>=4. A separate expanded-quartic replay matches all final integers; a fresh computation reproduces the input checkpoint byte for byte. The inspected published S_4 bound is 40/153; independent correctness and priority checks remain pending. Unbiased T4 has original p=1/5 and is not settled by this draft.
assumptions: One active root frog and one sleeper at each non-root vertex
Independent walks with original inward drift 19/80 and root reflection
Published GTW fixed point/lower coupling and Mathews degree monotonicity

relations.rationale: The draft uses the "GTW polynomial" at d=4. The published statement provides "g=A_(d,pi)g on 0<=x<1"; the draft separately proves its four-child monotonicity and tail.
The draft finite start "T^1000 1<=g_20" becomes recurrence by the method statement "Tg_a<=g_(a+1/1000) for every a>=20" and its monotone physical fixed point.
